<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public array $labels,
        public ?array $counters,
        public ?array $free,
        public ?array $closed,
        public ?array $patterned,
        public ?array $bare,
        public ?array $nestedMap,
        public ?array $listMap,
        public ?array $withProps,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            labels: $data['labels'],
            counters: $data['counters'],
            free: $data['free'],
            closed: $data['closed'],
            patterned: $data['patterned'],
            bare: $data['bare'],
            nestedMap: $data['nestedMap'],
            listMap: $data['listMap'],
            withProps: $data['withProps'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'labels' => $this->labels,
            'counters' => $this->counters,
            'free' => $this->free,
            'closed' => $this->closed,
            'patterned' => $this->patterned,
            'bare' => $this->bare,
            'nestedMap' => $this->nestedMap,
            'listMap' => $this->listMap,
            'withProps' => $this->withProps,
        ];
    }
}
